notes.title: Race 2nd Edition (Patch 10/15/18)
notes.content:
This update brings Race in line with the recently released 2nd Edition of the physical version. 

The base set has balance tweaks to a few cards.
- Biohazard Mining Guild - cost/vp reduced: 3/2  -> 2/0
- Black Market Trading World - cost/vp reduced: 3/2 -> 2/1
- Imperium Armaments World - cost reduced 4 -> 3
- Merchant Guild - added VP bonus of 1vp/good in empire
- Outlaw World - added +1 Military power

Added small 'moon icons' to worlds card to help with color-blindness. 

Fixed bug with the interaction of Galactic Scavengers and Pay Good to Reduce Cost powers.

Games started before the patch will continue to use the 1st edition cards. All new games post-patch will use the 2nd edition.

notes.title: Patch 1/10/18 (1436)
notes.content:
Minor patch to correct issues found with the expansion.

- Recompute stats option
- Improved 6 cost dev calculations with oort world
- Many fixes to the OK button being incorrectly available (which could lead to corrupt games)
- Log 'page 0' shows the game creation parameters
- Arrow keys scroll through zoomed cards (thanks Tridenz!)
- Other minor fixes and improvements
